findings.USER_IMPACT: A learner following a study-support title could not reach the referenced material directly.
findings.EVIDENCE: FlashcardDerivationService supplied material_id, but the review template linked every reference to /study-library.
findings.REPRODUCTION: Open a revealed flashcard with study references and activate a reference title.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: The learner template discarded the material identity already present in derived references.

findings.USER_IMPACT: Learners on an examination detail page had no direct way to open the material library filtered to that board.
findings.EVIDENCE: home/exam.php linked to practice and exam mode but had no study-library link; StudyLibraryService already supports board filtering.
findings.REPRODUCTION: Open /exams?exam=LET and inspect the board actions.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: The board detail template did not connect its available study-material route.

findings.USER_IMPACT: Every page displayed an obsolete v0.1 footer on the v1.0.1 product.
findings.EVIDENCE: The shared layout contained a literal BoardPrep v0.1 label.
findings.REPRODUCTION: Open any production learner page and inspect the footer.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: The footer version was hard-coded and not connected to release configuration.

findings.USER_IMPACT: Learners had no in-product explanation that progress is tied to a browser session and remains server-side after cookie clearing.
findings.EVIDENCE: No privacy/data handling route or notice was present in the production route table or shared navigation.
findings.REPRODUCTION: Review production navigation and footer before Batch 662.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: The release documented session settings but did not disclose learner-state behavior to learners.
DEPENDENCIES: Site-specific privacy terms remain an open launch capability.

findings.USER_IMPACT: A learner could mistake exam mode for a timed, exact official exam replica.
findings.EVIDENCE: Exam-mode route supports exam-style answer withholding and selectable counts; no timer is enforced and exact board-format coverage was not demonstrated.
findings.REPRODUCTION: Open quiz setup, select Exam Simulation, and inspect the setup instructions and session behavior.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: The mode's supported limits were not disclosed at its point of use.
DEPENDENCIES: A timer and official-format implementation remain deferred.

findings.USER_IMPACT: Learners could read a question explanation but could not follow its linked source-backed material from practice feedback or result review.
findings.EVIDENCE: All 8,962 canonical questions have entries in study-question-links.json; quiz views did not render those links before Batch 662.
findings.REPRODUCTION: Submit an answer or open a historical result for a linked question and look for a study-support link.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: Question-to-material mappings were used by data validation and flashcard derivation but not connected to learner quiz templates.

findings.USER_IMPACT: A valid source registry was reported invalid by the existing source/study regression check, obscuring genuine provenance defects and making the test suite fail.
findings.EVIDENCE: The committed sources.json uses 11 additional source_type categories that SourceRegistryService::validate() did not accept.
findings.REPRODUCTION: Run php tools/Tests/SourceStudyLibraryTest.php against the Batch 661 baseline.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: The validator's hard-coded allowed-type list was not updated with the committed source taxonomy.

findings.USER_IMPACT: Practice entry points for seven board codes could lead to an empty question pool even though the selected board had eligible questions.
findings.EVIDENCE: QuestionEligibilityService and QuestionEligibilityIndex normalized LET/CSE aliases only; direct checks found no match for CLE, NLE, PLE, CE, ME, REE, or ARCH against their configured board IDs. TenBoardLearnerJourneyHttpTest now exercises each public code through production HTTP.
findings.REPRODUCTION: Start /quiz with exam=CLE, NLE, PLE, CE, ME, REE, or ARCH and a board-eligible subject; before the fix selection returned no eligible question.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: Board short codes were not normalized to the canonical board IDs used by eligibility records.

findings.FEATURE: Effective board subjects and practice setup
findings.USER_IMPACT: Board detail pages could omit available subjects, and practice settings exposed only LET/CSE subject options, making direct focused practice inaccessible or misleading for other boards.
findings.EVIDENCE: home/exam.php rendered configured board-subject relations and linked subject codes, while runtime eligibility resolves effective blueprint subjects. Quiz settings contained hard-coded English/CSE options. TenBoardLearnerJourneyHttpTest verifies displayed effective subjects lead to an eligible question and complete results for every board.
findings.REPRODUCTION: Open /exams?exam=CPA or another board and follow a displayed subject into practice; before the fix, the page could show no usable subject action or submit a nonmatching subject.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: The board detail and quiz setup UI were not built from the same effective subject IDs used by question eligibility and selection.

missing_capabilities.FEATURE: Owner-approved deployment privacy terms and provider/log/backup disclosures
missing_capabilities.USER_IMPACT: Learners cannot yet identify the real site operator, contact channel, approved retention policy, or deployment-specific hosting/log/backup practices.
missing_capabilities.EVIDENCE: The privacy page supports owner-supplied environment configuration and clearly blocks public readiness when terms are absent. No real owner/provider values or approval were supplied for this batch.
missing_capabilities.REPRODUCTION: Open /privacy with no approved PRIVACY_* configuration; the application warns that public launch must wait for owner-approved terms.
missing_capabilities.ROOT_CAUSE: The application cannot invent legal/operator facts; the deployment owner and host must provide and approve these terms.
missing_capabilities.TEST_COVERAGE: tools/Tests/AnonymousLearnerPrivacyHttpTest.php verifies safe fail-closed disclosure; provider/legal approval remains unverified.
DEPENDENCIES: Real deployment owner and hosting contract

missing_capabilities.FEATURE: Session-scoped learner data export and deletion
missing_capabilities.USER_IMPACT: Without these controls, anonymous learners could neither inspect nor clear the application records tied to their current browser session.
missing_capabilities.EVIDENCE: Production privacy HTTP tests verify scoped export, CSRF and explicit confirmation, deletion of attempts/weakness/flashcard state, session rotation, idempotence, and preservation of another learner and aggregate statistics.
missing_capabilities.REPRODUCTION: Open /privacy, export the current session's records, then confirm a POST to /privacy/data/clear.
missing_capabilities.ROOT_CAUSE: The frozen release had disclosure only and no learner-facing data control route.
DEPENDENCIES: Owner-approved retention and hosting/log/backup terms remain tracked separately in BP662-CAP-001

missing_capabilities.USER_IMPACT: An anonymous learner cannot recover progress after switching browser/device or clearing the session cookie.
missing_capabilities.EVIDENCE: LearnerIdentityService stores a random ID in the PHP session; no account, login, password recovery, or identity linking routes exist. Cross-device access appears in long-term vision, not frozen MVP scope.
missing_capabilities.REPRODUCTION: Complete an attempt and open the app in a new browser session; learner history is not linked.
missing_capabilities.ROOT_CAUSE: The MVP intentionally uses anonymous browser-session identity.

missing_capabilities.FEATURE: Timed, official-format exam simulation for every board
missing_capabilities.USER_IMPACT: The current exam mode does not enforce a time limit and does not demonstrate official-format fidelity across all ten boards.
missing_capabilities.EVIDENCE: ExamSimulationHttpTest covers a short LET exam-mode flow; no learner-side timer was found in the mode UI or lifecycle.
missing_capabilities.REPRODUCTION: Choose Exam Simulation in quiz setup and observe that no countdown or time limit is applied.
missing_capabilities.ROOT_CAUSE: The v1 MVP implements an exam-mode quiz workflow, not a complete timed replica of every board exam.
DEPENDENCIES: Official format and duration evidence per board
